title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I am 23 years of age, about 13 or 14 years ago my mother had told my Aunt (mother's younger sister) that she(my mother) would do marriage of me with her(Aunt's) daughter, and since the time this came to know me (7-8 years before) I have been refusing time and time again. And now some months before my mother wanted to make my engagement with my Aunt's(mother's younger sister) daughter, and on that occasion i refused with much anger, Actually i can't spend even a day with them (Aunt's Family), I can't comprmise with them. My mother told me a few days before that if I don't do so, "do wherever you want and I would not live with your wife and you as well". Actually my Aunt has no son (had but died) and my mother says that this marriage would help her out, but I think if it happens so this would end with much pain and sufferings. And so thats why I am much disturbed now a days because of this situation. Due to this situation I had been stopped talking with my mother for a month but now it looks fine enough. Whole of my family is with me including my father. What should i do now? Please help me out. 2683 views Q. What was the amount of mahr that Hadhrat Usman bin Affan (RA) gave to Hadhrat Ruqayyah (RA)? What were materials that the Holy Prophet (peace be upon him ) gave to Hadhrat Usman bin Affan (RA) as dowry? 6421 views Q. If a shia girl admits in front of her mother that she does NOT follow shiaism but totally follow 'Ahlay Sunnat wal jamat'the question is; Is it right for a sunni man to marry her,or has she is to take the Shahada in front of other witnesses?please clarify? 2687 views Q. We are writing this email to you as we are in utter distress. My husband and I both are born Muslims (Alhamdulillah) from India and are currently residing in the UAE. We have a grownup daughter who had gone to Canada for higher studies. There she met one Sikh boy and they decided to get married; now our daughter is asking our permission. The girl is 23 years of age and the boy is 27. Both are having good jobs in their respective country of residences. Facts: The boy is ready to accept Islam before getting married to the girl. The boy is ready to come to the UAE to revert to Islam, learn everything and get married as per the Muslim tradition. (Nikah) The conversion is going to be kept secret from the boys parents. Currently the boys parents are ready to accept a Muslim girl as their daughter-in-law. After the wedding the girl will be living with the boy and his parents in the same house. The boys parents do not have any objection to the girl following her faith in their house. The boy will be following/practicing Islam in secrecy. The boy is their only male child so he cannot abandon them to live separately with the girl. As the girls parents we met the boy and his family. The boy is very nice and sincere and is promising that he would follow the new faith and will keep our daughter happy. The parents are also very nice also said that they have no issues if the girl is going to continue to keep her faith after marrying their boy. But they do not wish their son to change his faith. Issues: (2) Is it correct for an individual to revert to Islam in secrecy of his parents and especially for a girl? (3) Will the boy be able to practice Islam in that house? (4) What will be the fate of their children? (5) The boy is promising us that their children will follow the faith of the mother (Islam) and not of the paternal grandparents (Sikhism). (6) Dilemma: If we give our consent to this marriage then we will be taking a big risk by allowing our daughter to spend the rest of her life with a threat of the boy going back to his old faith (7) If we say no then we are afraid of stopping/denying an individual to embrace Islam. We are requesting you to kindly guide us with either Fatwa or advise so as to make the decision easy for us. As we love our daughter like all parents; we are trying to work a way for her happiness. Kindly treat this matter as URGENT and reply as soon as possible. 4941 views Q. I want to know if Nikah remains in existence if the couple whose marriage has been solemnized four years ago, but still they have no physical relation as the marriage was done forcefully 3343 views Q. I am 19 yrs old and the girl i like is 18yrs. we r in a lovng relationship from 1.5 years. we talk over phone and almost evry weekend we go on long drive in my car. 3847 views Q. I am 27 year old girl whose parents are tabligh. I married a man of my own wish who is also hanafi but is of silsila qadriya. my father object to my marriage and kidnapped me. is this permissable in islam. Also i have been separated from husband for 5 months. Father refuses to allow me to go back. we are from gujarat india. is this all permissable in islam. 5136 views Q. Hi ASSALAMALAIKUM, one of my friend is looking his life partner,she is very religious,good and he is interested to marry(NIKAH) her. but she is elder than him as per certificates, but her parents are saying the date of birth is wrongly entered in certificates , as per KHURAN this NIKAH is acceptable or not. Please give all details. Please help him.I would be very grateful to you for helping him . Thank you very much. Allah hafiz. 1910 views Q. Is it mustahab, mustaqil sunnah or sunnat-e-Ghair Muwakkidah to perform nikah in the mosque? 3534 views Q. Assalam Alaikum Mufti Sahab, I was in love in love with a girl from last 2 years..we met 7 times,in which we got engaged ourself in illegal activities.we both perform namaz 5 times and try to follow sunnah to the best.whenever we did an illegal act,we use to realize it that it is wrong,so we use to perform 2 rakat salat-ut-tauba.But as the time passed,we lost control on ourself so last month we decided to get married,so that talking on fone,meeting and doing other things will become halaal for us..we did'nt informed at our home and we did nikaah with her n myself(there was no qazi,wali and 2 proof).I read all the nikah text from quran and hadith and asked her 3 times whether u accept me as ur husband..she said yes..and i said by myself for mine acceptance.my motto behind nikaah was to have an halaal relationship..Allah knows it better..Now i want to know whether we are husband-wife or not..we both consider ourself as couple.I have read in 1 of your fatwa that if a girl says a boy,i am ur wife and she uses his sirname...then also she becomes wife..plzz clear my doubt..I am always in tention...waiting for ur reply..Duao ki dharkhaast 5405 views Q. What should parent do when their daughter run from house and get married with her boffriend. specially when she was engaged 3 months back with some other man with her consent and parents consent too. Its been 1 year parent never see her nor talk with her. Is it acceptable that parent will never see her face. 2780 views Q. Validity of nikah in state of haiz (menses?) 68037 views Q. Is waleema mandatory? 3292 views Q. I want to know we had marriage in court in front of Qazi and advocate without involving our parents 3617 views Q. I want to know that, if a muslim boy married to a non muslim or a muslim girl married to a non muslim boy is non islamik as per islamic belief. 2376 views
answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 150621 Country: india Title: Marriage with chachi's daughter Question: I want to ask a question about milk feeding and nikah. My mother fed milk to my big cousin brother and my aunt also fed milk to my big brother but I am 3rd number after my brother who feed milk of aunt I want nikah with my cousin (name not mentioned)who is 4th number after my cousin brother who fed milk of my mother now I want fatwa may I nikah with my cousin(name not mentioned) or not. Answer ID: 150621 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 932/852/SN=8/1438) In the question mentioned above you may marry that daughter of your chachi , there is no issue according to the Shariah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
